focus: Equipment that keeps interrupting pool time

A new grinding, rattling, or air-related sound is worth documenting. The noise can relate to flow, prime, an obstruction, or worn components; it is not enough on its own to order a motor. Choose a weekly-care discussion when the equipment operates normally and your main concern is recurring debris and routine water care.
